parameters.jsCode:
const d = $json;

// alle beim Start geladenen EUDAMED-Seeds
const seeds = $('DB Seeds')
  .all()
  .map(item => item.json);

// EUDAMED liefert MF_SRN im Device selbst zurück.
// Damit ordnen wir jedes Device wieder unserem internen Unternehmen zu.
const srn = String(d.MF_SRN || '')
  .trim()
  .toUpperCase();

const seed = seeds.find(s =>
  String(s.MANUFACTURER_SRN || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase() === srn
);

if (!seed) {
  throw new Error(
    `Keine APPLICANT_ID für EUDAMED MF_SRN ${d.MF_SRN} gefunden`
  );
}

// Suchtext für CI-Klassifikation
const haystack = [
  d.TRADE_NAME,
  d.DEVICE_NAME,
  d.DEVICE_MODEL,
  d.REFERENCE,
  d.MEDICAL_PURPOSE
]
.filter(Boolean)
.join(" ")
.toUpperCase();

const topics = [
  {
    name: "NEPHRIN",
    terms: [
      "NEPHRIN",
      "ANTI-NEPHRIN",
      "ANTI NEPHRIN"
    ]
  },
  {
    name: "MEMBRANOUS_NEPHROPATHY",
    terms: [
      "PLA2R",
      "THSD7A",
      "NELL1",
      "NELL-1"
    ]
  },
  {
    name: "NEURODEGENERATION",
    terms: [
      "P217",
      "P-TAU217",
      "PTAU217",
      "TAU217",
      "GFAP",
      "NEUROFILAMENT",
      "NFL",
      "AMYLOID",
      "ABETA",
      "AΒETA"
    ]
  }
];

const matchedTopics = topics
  .filter(topic =>
    topic.terms.some(term =>
      haystack.includes(term.toUpperCase())
    )
  )
  .map(topic => topic.name);

return {
  EUDAMED_ID: d.ID ?? null,
  EUDAMED_UUID: d.UUID ?? null,
  UDI_DI_DATA_ULID: d.UDI_DI_DATA_ULID ?? null,

  PRIMARY_DI: d.PRIMARY_DI ?? null,
  BASIC_UDI: d.BASIC_UDI ?? null,

  APPLICANT_ID: Number(seed.APPLICANT_ID),

  MANUFACTURER_SRN: d.MF_SRN ?? seed.MANUFACTURER_SRN ?? null,
  MANUFACTURER_NAME: d.MF_NAME ?? seed.MANUFACTURER_NAME ?? null,

  TRADE_NAME: d.TRADE_NAME ?? null,
  DEVICE_NAME: d.DEVICE_NAME ?? null,
  DEVICE_MODEL: d.DEVICE_MODEL ?? null,
  REFERENCE: d.REFERENCE ?? null,

  NOMENCLATURE_CODE:
    d.NOMENCLATURE_CODE
      ? String(d.NOMENCLATURE_CODE).trim()
      : null,

  RISK_CLASS_ID: d.RISK_CLASS_ID ?? null,
  APPLICABLE_LEGISLATION_ID:
    d.APPLICABLE_LEGISLATION_ID ?? null,

  DEVICE_CRITERION:
    d.DEVICE_CRITERION ?? null,

  PLACED_ON_THE_MARKET_ID:
    d.PLACED_ON_THE_MARKET_ID ?? null,

  DEVICE_STATUS_TYPE_ID:
    d.DEVICE_STATUS_TYPE_ID ?? null,

  STATUS_ID:
    d.STATUS_ID ?? null,

  VERSION_NUMBER:
    d.VERSION_NUMBER ?? null,

  LATEST_VERSION:
    d.LATEST_VERSION ?? null,

  NEW_DEVICE:
    d.NEW_DEVICE ?? null,

  REAGENT:
    d.REAGENT ?? null,

  INSTRUMENT:
    d.INSTRUMENT ?? null,

  KIT:
    d.KIT ?? null,

  PROFESSIONAL_TESTING:
    d.PROFESSIONAL_TESTING ?? null,

  SELF_TESTING:
    d.SELF_TESTING ?? null,

  NEAR_PATIENT_TESTING:
    d.NEAR_PATIENT_TESTING ?? null,

  COMPANION_DIAGNOSTICS:
    d.COMPANION_DIAGNOSTICS ?? null,

  AR_NAME:
    d.AR_NAME ?? null,

  AR_SRN:
    d.AR_SRN ?? null,

  TOPIC_MATCH:
    matchedTopics.length
      ? matchedTopics.join(",")
      : null,

  PAYLOAD_JSON:
    JSON.stringify(d)
};

parameters.query:
SELECT
    c.APPLICANT_ID,
    c.APPLICANT,
    e.MANUFACTURER_NAME,
    e.MANUFACTURER_SRN
FROM infofee01_fda.if_regulatory_company c
JOIN infofee01_fda.if_regulatory_eudamed_mf e
    ON e.APPLICANT_ID = c.APPLICANT_ID
WHERE
    c.EUDAMED_ACTIVE = 1
    AND e.ACTIVE = 1
ORDER BY
    c.APPLICANT_ID,
    e.MANUFACTURER_SRN;
